title: The Target
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Oscar fears Angela may have discovered his affair with her husband, leading to tension and plans for revenge. Angela enlists Dwight and Trevor to arrange a violent retaliation against Oscar. Meanwhile, Jim prepares to ask for part-time work to focus on his sports marketing company, and Pam starts painting a warehouse mural but causes a client loss with a prank call. The episode culminates in confrontations between Angela and Oscar, Dwight preventing Trevor from attacking Oscar, and office dynamics adjusting to Jim's impending absence.
